name: airlock-jira
description: Read and update Jira from the internet-isolated internal (island) network using the airlock-jira CLI — the only path to Jira there. Relays every call internal → Aurora → S3 → external worker → real Jira and back, with no outbound internet or credentials on the island. Covers reads, guarded comment/transition writes, and preflight (SSM tunnel + creds) fixes.
